seo.metaTitle: Cover letter generator — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Generate a structured, concise cover letter tailored to a company and role without uploading your resume to third-party job portals. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/forms/cover-letter-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Cover letter generator processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/forms/cover-letter-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does Cover letter generator upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Cover letter generator executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/forms/cover-letter-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.
